title: Flip Square Submatrix Vertically
description:
You are given an m × n integer matrix grid, along with three integers x, y, and k.

(x, y) represents the top-left corner of a square submatrix.
k represents the side length of that submatrix.

Your task is to flip this k × k submatrix vertically, meaning you reverse the order of its rows while keeping the columns unchanged.

Return the updated matrix after performing this operation.
input_format:
The first line contains two integers m and n.
The next m lines each contain n space-separated integers.
The next three lines each contain one integer: x, y, and k.
output_format: Print the result line by line using space-separated integers.
constraints:
m == grid.length
n == grid[i].length
1 ≤ m, n ≤ 50
1 ≤ grid[i][j] ≤ 100
0 ≤ x < m
0 ≤ y < n
1 ≤ k ≤ min(m - x, n - y)
